MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

3. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 8
   D. 24.5

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 120

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

6. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

7. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x = 5

8. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 4

9. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15.7

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

11. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 1

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 36
   C. 45
   D. 18

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

16. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 6

17. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31
   D. 37

18. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

19. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. Cannot tell

20. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 22
   C. 38
   D. 88

21. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

22. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 14
   C. 33
   D. 22

24. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
